gen-gf-revalia-gf-anuphan: Expressive is the first word that comes to mind for Revalia, with its wide-striding letters and an open-tailed g that loves attention. Anuphan stays quietly clean beneath it, and its big round bowls do the patient work of carrying the text.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-arimo: Revalia's widely separated letters and tall, bold band give the heading a loose, confident swagger. Arimo handles the quieter job, keeping its rounded shapes spacious and its sans lines tidy while the heading does the shouting.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-athiti: Revalia strides wide and bold, its horizontals dropping low and its g leaving the lower curve open. Athiti, a friendly sans-serif with a high mean line and see-through s shapes, feels like a lighter, more approachable neighbor.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Atkinson Hyperlegible is a plain sans with clipped-looking capitals and ascenders, and wide-set terminals that keep each s distinct. And a long stretch of it should feel steady and approachable, while Revalia stays the loud, display-sized voice up top.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-: That open-tailed g and relaxed, wide-set stride make Revalia feel bold and expressive before you read a word. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono then lets a longer passage breathe, its open counters and stretched spacing giving the text plenty of white space.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-biryani: Biryani reads approachable and clean, with a large eye on every e and counters that never clog. Revalia is the one for bold, wide display moments, while Biryani is built for steady, uniform text.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-blinker: Loud, loose and wide-striding, Revalia comes with an open-tailed g and a tall, bold band of letters. Blinker, a sans-serif whose lowercase fills most of the height, rewards a slightly larger size so its open apertures show.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-carrois-gothic: Revalia's wide, relaxed stride and open-tailed g give the heading plenty of expressive weight, in a display style all its own. Carrois Gothic is a modern sans-serif that does well at a modest size.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Wide, bold and a bit theatrical, Revalia leans on its open-tailed g and tall letter band. And Carrois Gothic SC, a contemporary sans with clear curve endings and capitals close to lowercase height, reads smoothly across a longer stretch.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-chivo: Bold energy comes from Revalia, with its widely separated letters and a g that leaves its lower curve open. And Chivo, a professional sans-serif with lowercase packed up toward the caps, would carry a longer passage with visible daylight in every curve.
